1.web: Then Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam sang on that day, saying,
1.asv: Then sang Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam on that day, saying,

2.web: “Because the leaders took the lead in Israel, because the people offered themselves willingly, be blessed, Yahweh!
2.asv: For that the leaders took the lead in Israel, For that the people offered themselves willingly, Bless ye Jehovah.

3.web: “Hear, you kings! Give ear, you princes! I, even I, will sing to Yahweh. I will sing praise to Yahweh, the God of Israel.
3.asv: Hear, O ye kings; give ear, O ye princes; I, evenI, will sing unto Jehovah; I will sing praise to Jehovah, the God of Israel.

4.web: “Yahweh, when you went out of Seir, when you marched out of the field of Edom, the earth trembled, the sky also dropped. Yes, the clouds dropped water.
4.asv: Jehovah, when thou wentest forth out of Seir, When thou marchedst out of the field of Edom, The earth trembled, the heavens also dropped, Yea, the clouds dropped water.

5.web: The mountains quaked at the presence of Yahweh, even Sinai, at the presence of Yahweh, the God of Israel.
5.asv: The mountains quaked at the presence of Jehovah, Even yon Sinai at the presence of Jehovah, the God of Israel.

6.web: “In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were unoccupied. The travelers walked through byways.
6.asv: In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath, In the days of Jael, the highways were unoccupied, And the travellers walked through byways.

7.web: The rulers ceased in Israel. They ceased until I, Deborah, arose; Until I arose a mother in Israel.
7.asv: The rulers ceased in Israel, they ceased, Until that I Deborah arose, That I arose a mother in Israel.

8.web: They chose new gods. Then war was in the gates. Was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Israel?
8.asv: They chose new gods; Then was war in the gates: Was there a shield or spear seen Among forty thousand in Israel?

9.web: My heart is toward the governors of Israel, who offered themselves willingly among the people. Bless Yahweh!
9.asv: My heart is toward the governors of Israel, That offered themselves willingly among the people: Bless ye Jehovah.

10.web: “Speak, you who ride on white donkeys, you who sit on rich carpets, and you who walk by the way.
10.asv: Tell of it, ye that ride on white asses, Ye that sit on rich carpets, And ye that walk by the way.

11.web: Far from the noise of archers, in the places of drawing water, there they will rehearse the righteous acts of Yahweh, the righteous acts of his rule in Israel. “Then the people of Yahweh went down to the gates.
11.asv: Far from the noise of archers, in the places of drawing water, There shall they rehearse the righteous acts of Jehovah, Eventhe righteous acts of his rule in Israel. Then the people of Jehovah went down to the gates.

12.web: ‘Awake, awake, Deborah! Awake, awake, utter a song! Arise, Barak, and lead away your captives, you son of Abinoam.’
12.asv: Awake, awake, Deborah; Awake, awake, utter a song: Arise, Barak, and lead away thy captives, thou son of Abinoam.

13.web: “Then a remnant of the nobles and the people came down. Yahweh came down for me against the mighty.
13.asv: Then came down a remnant of the nobles and the people; Jehovah came down for me against the mighty.

14.web: Those whose root is in Amalek came out of Ephraim, after you, Benjamin, among your peoples. Governors come down out of Machir. Those who handle the marshal’s staff came out of Zebulun.
14.asv: Out of Ephraimcame downthey whose root is in Amalek; After thee, Benjamin, among thy peoples; Out of Machir came down governors, And out of Zebulun they that handle the marshal’s staff.

15.web: The princes of Issachar were with Deborah. As was Issachar, so was Barak. They rushed into the valley at his feet. By the watercourses of Reuben, there were great resolves of heart.
15.asv: And the princes of Issachar were with Deborah; As was Issachar, so was Barak; Into the valley they rushed forth at his feet. By the watercourses of Reuben There were great resolves of heart.

16.web: Why did you sit among the sheepfolds, To hear the whistling for the flocks? At the watercourses of Reuben There were great searchings of heart.
16.asv: Why sattest thou among the sheepfolds, To hear the pipings for the flocks? At the watercourses of Reuben There were great searchings of heart.

17.web: Gilead lived beyond the Jordan. Why did Dan remain in ships? Asher sat still at the haven of the sea, and lived by his creeks.
17.asv: Gilead abode beyond the Jordan: And Dan, why did he remain in ships? Asher sat still at the haven of the sea, And abode by his creeks.

18.web: Zebulun was a people that jeopardized their lives to the deaths; Naphtali also, on the high places of the field.
18.asv: Zebulun was a people that jeoparded their lives unto the death, And Naphtali, upon the high places of the field.

19.web: “The kings came and fought, then the kings of Canaan fought at Taanach by the waters of Megiddo. They took no plunder of silver.
19.asv: The kings came and fought; Then fought the kings of Canaan, In Taanach by the waters of Megiddo: They took no gain of money.

20.web: From the sky the stars fought. From their courses, they fought against Sisera.
20.asv: From heaven fought the stars, From their courses they fought against Sisera.

21.web: The river Kishon swept them away, that ancient river, the river Kishon. My soul, march on with strength.
21.asv: The river Kishon swept them away, That ancient river, the river Kishon. O my soul, march on with strength.

22.web: Then the horse hoofs stamped because of the prancings, the prancings of their strong ones.
22.asv: Then did the horsehoofs stamp By reason of the prancings, the prancings of their strong ones.

23.web: ‘Curse Meroz,’ said Yahweh’s angel. ‘Curse bitterly its inhabitants, because they didn’t come to help Yahweh, to help Yahweh against the mighty.’
23.asv: Curse ye Meroz, said the angel of Jehovah. Curse ye bitterly the inhabitants thereof, Because they came not to the help of Jehovah, To the help of Jehovah against the mighty.

24.web: “Jael shall be blessed above women, the wife of Heber the Kenite; blessed shall she be above women in the tent.
24.asv: Blessed above women shall Jael be, The wife of Heber the Kenite; Blessed shall she be above women in the tent.

25.web: He asked for water. She gave him milk. She brought him butter in a lordly dish.
25.asv: He asked water, andshe gave him milk; She brought him butter in a lordly dish.

26.web: She put her hand to the tent peg, and her right hand to the workmen’s hammer. With the hammer she struck Sisera. She struck through his head. Yes, she pierced and struck through his temples.
26.asv: She put her hand to the tent-pin, And her right hand to the workmen’s hammer; And with the hammer she smote Sisera, she smote through his head; Yea, she pierced and struck through his temples.

27.web: At her feet he bowed, he fell, he lay. At her feet he bowed, he fell. Where he bowed, there he fell down dead.
27.asv: At her feet he bowed, he fell, he lay; At her feet he bowed, he fell: Where he bowed, there he fell down dead.

28.web: “Through the window she looked out, and cried: Sisera’s mother looked through the lattice. ‘Why is his chariot so long in coming? Why do the wheels of his chariots wait?’
28.asv: Through the window she looked forth, and cried, The mother of Siseracriedthrough the lattice, Why is his chariot so long in coming? Why tarry the wheels of his chariots?

29.web: Her wise ladies answered her, Yes, she returned answer to herself,
29.asv: Her wise ladies answered her, Yea, she returned answer to herself,

30.web: ‘Have they not found, have they not divided the plunder? A lady, two ladies to every man; to Sisera a plunder of dyed garments, a plunder of dyed garments embroidered, of dyed garments embroidered on both sides, on the necks of the plunder?’
30.asv: Have they not found, have they not divided the spoil? A damsel, two damsels to every man; To Sisera a spoil of dyed garments, A spoil of dyed garments embroidered, Of dyed garments embroidered on both sides, on the necks of the spoil?

31.web: “So let all your enemies perish, Yahweh, but let those who love him be as the sun when it rises in its strength.” Then the land had rest forty years.
31.asv: So let all thine enemies perish, O Jehovah: But let them that love him be as the sun when he goeth forth in his might. And the land had rest forty years.
